The completion claim is **partially supported**. 

**Established:**
- The script demonstrates basic rendering functionality (OpenGL context, 60 FPS)
- Gameplay elements are present (world generation, keyboard input)
- System initialization completes successfully

**Unverified:**
- Actual game content or mechanics beyond basic startup
- True rendering quality vs. Mesa llvmpipe software rendering
- Full gameplay functionality and user interaction
- Performance consistency beyond the 3-second test

The script confirms minimal system operation but cannot verify comprehensive "real rendering and gameplay" as claimed, since it only tests startup sequences with limited verification.
